answer: Sorry, the help center doesn't explain how to get a loan payoff number or whether Northwind Auto provides one, so please contact a store directly for help with your Harbor payoff. If your loan is already paid off but Harbor is still listed as lienholder on the title, ask Harbor for a lien release letter. If you can't get one, you can sign form NW-LRL-1 and we'll contact the lender for you, which can add 1 to 2 weeks.
